text.en: BIG-bench is row 68 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Evaluation Analysis area.
text.zh: BIG-bench 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 68 行，所属领域为“评测与分析”。

text.en: The annual table associates BIG-bench with “Beyond the Imitation Game: Quantifying and extrapolating the capabilities of language models”.
text.zh: 年度表把 BIG-bench 与论文《Beyond the Imitation Game: Quantifying and extrapolating the capabilities of language models》关联。
